help.short: The ID of the policy assignment to get. Use the format '{scope}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyAssignments/{policyAssignmentName}'.
Comma-separated list of additional properties to be included in the response. Supported values are 'LatestDefinitionVersion, EffectiveDefinitionVersion'.

description: Get operation retrieves the policy assignment with the given ID. Policy assignment IDs have this format: '{scope}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyAssignments/{policyAssignmentName}'. Valid scopes are: management group (format: '/providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/{managementGroup}'), subscription (format: '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}'), resource group (format: '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}', or resource (format: '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/[{parentResourcePath}/]{resourceType}/{resourceName}'.
